title: "Tools & Data"
description: "Reusable datasets, dashboards, templates, automated reports, research tools, and public data resources."

Tools & Data collects reusable materials that make analysis easier to inspect, repeat, or adapt: datasets, dashboards, templates, automated reports, research tools, and public data resources.

## Reusable Resources

:::: {.index-list}
::: {.index-item}
### Public Dataset Placeholder

A cleaned dataset concept with documentation, field definitions, licensing notes, and reproducible scripts.

**Status:** Draft  
**Materials:** CSV, notes, analysis output
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Classification Export Placeholder

Structured classification outputs and validation summaries for reviewed research or content datasets.

**Status:** Planned  
**Materials:** Export table, codebook, review notes
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Reporting Bundle Placeholder

A recurring report dataset and rendered output package with source notes and an audit trail.

**Status:** Planned  
**Materials:** Source notes, rendered report, audit log
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Dashboard and Report Templates

Reusable layouts for metric definitions, source notes, recurring reports, and stakeholder summaries.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Research Tools

Codebooks, qualitative coding sheets, public-data reference files, and repeatable scripts for research workflows.
:::
::::
